content: A new firmware update for the $449 Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 adds support for Bluetooth LE Audio and Auracast as beta features. The flagship Ultra headphones are the first from Bose to support the audio sharing technology, which the company plans to bring to more devices soon. Only a few major manufacturers include Auracast, and only on select headphones or earbuds — including Sony, JBL headphones, Samsung Galaxy Buds, and Sennheiser, which also released an Auracast transmitter this year. Some smaller companies, like EarFun, have added support. But Bose is one of the most recognizable names in headphones, so the fact that it’s finally jumping in is big news for Auracast. Auracast was officially announced back in 2022, but the adoption process has been slow. The technology allows a device to broadcast Bluetooth audio to any number of supported headphones or speakers at the same time. This could be for gate announcements while waiting at the airport, a performance at a local venue, or a college lecture. You can even use Auracast at home to watch TV while kids are asleep or for extra hearing assistance — some Samsung and LG TVs have the functionality buried in their menus. The firmware update, labeled 10.12.12, has been quietly rolling out the past few weeks. Alongside Bluetooth LE and Auracast, it adds improved audio over wired USB connections, including balance for gaming audio and chat, and better compatibility for web conferencing apps. Bose spokesperson Tim Williams told The Verge via email that the QC Headphones (Gen 2), which I recently reviewed, should get the beta firmware next.

chineseContent: 售价 449 美元的 Bose QuietComfort Ultra 耳机 Gen 2 的新固件更新增加了对蓝牙 LE 音频和 Auracast 测试版功能的支持。旗舰产品 Ultra 耳机是 Bose 首款支持音频共享技术的耳机，该公司计划很快将其推广到更多设备。只有少数几家主要制造商使用 Auracast，并且仅在部分耳机或耳塞上使用，包括索尼、JBL 耳机、三星 Galaxy Buds 和 Sennheiser，后者今年也发布了 Auracast 发射器。一些较小的公司（例如 EarFun）增加了支持。但 Bose 是耳机领域最知名的品牌之一，因此它最终加入进来对于 Auracast 来说是个大新闻。 Auracast 于 2022 年正式宣布，但采用过程进展缓慢。该技术允许设备同时向任意数量的支持的耳机或扬声器广播蓝牙音频。这可能是在机场等候时的登机口公告、当地场馆的表演或大学讲座。您甚至可以在家中使用 Auracast 在孩子睡觉时看电视或获得额外的听力帮助 - 一些三星和 LG 电视的菜单中隐藏了该功能。标记为 10.12.12 的固件更新在过去几周已悄然推出。除了蓝牙 LE 和 Auracast 之外，它还通过有线 USB 连接添加了改进的音频，包括游戏音频和聊天的平衡，以及网络会议应用程序的更好兼容性。 Bose 发言人 Tim Williams 通过电子邮件告诉 The Verge，我最近评测过的 QC 耳机（第 2 代）接下来应该会获得测试版固件。
